summary: Kootenai National Forest L-4 tower near Trout Creek, Montana, built 1934 and marked gone from 1955; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.com marks it 'Gone 1955'; the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Montana list marks it as gone

events.note: Firelookout.com: '1934: 10' L-4 tower'; the page does not say what the 10 feet measures
Firelookout.com: 'Gone 1955'; the page gives no cause

evidence.supports: the lookout is in the Kootenai National Forest
about 13 miles east-northeast of Trout Creek
listed as a tower with status Gone
a hiking listing names a Moose Peak Trail in Sanders County
evidence.quote: Moose Peak Trail in Sanders County, Montana

notes_for_editor: Two pages from firelookout.com and the FFLA list give the record; the trail citation is a generic travel listing, used only for the trail's name. Not used: a Forest Lookouts page for Moose Point (Flathead NF) that quotes a 1934 newspaper item about a 'lookout station on Moose Peak' and a 1951 item about a 7,521-foot 'Moose lookout'. That page files both under Moose Point, so the editor should check whether Moose Peak (Kootenai, 6,010 ft) and Moose Point are being confused before anyone uses them. Firelookout.com's '10'' figure is not explained, so the story does not state a height. PeakVisor lists 6,017 ft against firelookout.com's 6,010 ft; not cited. A Forest Service trail page (recid 82621) returned by search did not load its trail text, so no agency source for the trail is cited. Story is about 110 words. Two WebSearch calls used.
